name: WDXL Lubrifont JP N
summary: Google Fonts specimen page for WDXL Lubrifont JP N, the Japanese (JIS2004) cut of the WD-XL Lubrifont typeface.
description: Specimen page for the WDXL Lubrifont JP N family on Google Fonts. The JP N cut carries JIS2004 Japanese glyphs, and the family's metadata lists Japanese and Cyrillic coverage. Source files for WD-XL Lubrifont are published at github.com/NightFurySL2001/WD-XL-font under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
contains: source files under SIL Open Font License 1.1
